claim: What do you think about Walmart? : r/AskAnAmerican - Reddit
summary: Walmart is a one-stop-shop where people who don't necessarily have a lot of money can get everything they need, and perhaps a few things they don't. As such, there are a wide variety of people there (everything from junkies to recent immigrants to farmers to people who just want a deal), and interesting things happen — especially late at night.
